lines: About Us
Welcome to The Handle Factory
At The Handle Factory, we believe that creating a comfortable, efficient, and well-equipped home starts with choosing the right products.
Operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD, we are a UK-based online retailer specialising in home heating solutions, fireplaces, power equipment, saunas, and essential accessories.

Through our online store, https://thehandlefactory.uk, we aim to make it easier for customers throughout the United Kingdom to explore and purchase products suited to their homes, properties, and everyday requirements.

Whether you're upgrading your heating system, improving your living space, preparing for unexpected power interruptions, or investing in home wellness equipment, The Handle Factory is here to help you make informed purchasing decisions.
Who We Are
The Handle Factory is an online retail business operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD, with its business address in London, England.
Our store focuses on bringing together a selection of home improvement, heating, and power equipment in one convenient online shopping destination.

We understand that purchasing products such as fireplaces, boilers, generators, and saunas requires careful consideration. Product specifications, compatibility, installation requirements, and ongoing performance can all influence the purchasing decision.
That's why we aim to provide clear product information, transparent store policies, and accessible customer support.
Our approach is straightforward: help customers find suitable products while providing a convenient and dependable shopping experience.
What We Offer
We offer products across six main categories.
1. Wood Stove Accessories
Explore accessories designed to complement wood-burning stoves and fireplace installations.
Our range may include fireplace tools, stove accessories, maintenance equipment, and other products intended to support the use and upkeep of compatible heating appliances.
2. Fireplaces
Discover fireplace solutions for a variety of interior spaces and heating requirements.
Whether you're exploring traditional designs or modern heating options, our fireplace category helps you compare available products, features, and specifications.
3. Generators
Explore generators designed for a range of domestic, outdoor, and backup power applications.
We encourage customers to review power output, fuel requirements, operating conditions, and safety instructions before choosing a generator.
4. Water Heaters
Browse water heating equipment intended for different household and property requirements.
Product suitability depends on factors such as capacity, energy source, installation requirements, and compatibility with existing systems.
5. Saunas
Explore sauna products designed to bring relaxation and wellness experiences into suitable home environments.
Our sauna category offers customers the opportunity to compare different configurations, dimensions, and features.
6. Furnaces & Boilers
Discover heating equipment designed for residential and other suitable applications.
Customers should carefully review product specifications and consult appropriately qualified installers before purchasing equipment that requires professional installation.
Our Mission
Our mission is to make shopping for home heating, power equipment, and related products more straightforward, transparent, and accessible.
We aim to achieve this by focusing on three priorities:
Product Information: Helping customers understand product features, specifications, and suitability before purchasing.
Customer Convenience: Providing a clear online shopping experience with accessible information about orders, delivery, returns, and support.
Responsible Service: Communicating store policies transparently and respecting customers' rights under applicable UK consumer protection laws.
We believe customers should be able to make purchasing decisions with confidence and understand what to expect throughout the ordering process.
Why Shop With The Handle Factory?
A Focused Product Selection
Our store brings together products across home heating, power equipment, and related categories, helping customers explore different options in one place.
Free UK Standard Shipping
We offer free standard shipping on all eligible orders throughout the United Kingdom, with no minimum order value.
Our standard estimated delivery timeframe is 5–7 business days, comprising 3 business days of order handling and 2–4 business days of shipping transit.
Delivery estimates are subject to applicable business days, public holidays, and carrier conditions.
30-Day Returns
We offer a 30-day return window for eligible products.
Our return arrangements include:
* Returns for defective and non-defective products
* Exchanges for eligible products
* Free prepaid return shipping
* No restocking fees
* A standard refund processing target of 10 days
For complete terms, please review our Returns & Refunds Policy.
Your statutory consumer rights remain unaffected.
Clear and Transparent Policies
We aim to provide accessible information about shipping, returns, cancellations, payments, and warranty support so customers can understand the relevant terms before placing an order.
Accessible Customer Support
Our customer support team can assist with product enquiries, order information, delivery questions, returns, and general after-sales support.
Customers can contact us by email or telephone using the details provided below.
Our Commitment to Customers
We recognise that purchasing heating systems, generators, and other significant household equipment is an important decision.
Our commitment is to provide:
* Clear and relevant product descriptions
* Transparent pricing in British Pounds Sterling (GBP)
* Free standard UK shipping
* Accessible information about delivery expectations
* Straightforward returns and refund procedures
* Assistance with order-related enquiries
* Respect for applicable UK consumer rights
Where products require specialist installation, we encourage customers to consult appropriately qualified professionals and follow manufacturer guidance.
We want customers to understand their purchases and the support available to them.
Shopping With Confidence
At The Handle Factory, we aim to provide a clear purchasing process from product selection through to delivery and after-sales assistance.
Before completing an order, customers can review product information, pricing, delivery estimates, and applicable store policies.
After placing an order, customers can use available tracking information or contact our support team for assistance.
If an issue arises, we encourage customers to get in touch so that we can review the circumstances and work towards an appropriate resolution.

blocks.question: Do you charge restocking fees?

blocks.question: How long does a refund take?

blocks.question: Can I return a product if I change my mind?

blocks.question: Do your products come with a warranty?
blocks.answer: Warranty coverage varies depending on the product and manufacturer. Where a manufacturer's or commercial warranty is available, the relevant details should be provided in the product information or accompanying documentation. Your statutory consumer rights apply independently of any commercial warranty.

blocks.question: Can you help me choose the right product?
blocks.answer: Yes. Our customer support team can assist with general product information, specifications, and compatibility enquiries. For installations involving gas, electrical systems, combustion appliances, or other safety-critical equipment, consult an appropriately qualified professional.

blocks.question: Do fireplaces and boilers require professional installation?
blocks.answer: Certain fireplaces, boilers, water heaters, and heating systems require professional installation to comply with safety regulations and manufacturer instructions. Depending on the appliance, this may require a Gas Safe registered engineer, a suitably qualified electrician, or another competent installer. Always check the specific product's installation requirements before purchasing.

blocks.question: Are generators suitable for indoor use?
blocks.answer: No. Petrol, diesel, and other fuel-burning generators must never be operated indoors or in enclosed spaces. They can produce deadly carbon monoxide. Always follow the manufacturer's safety instructions and use the equipment only in suitable outdoor locations.

lines: Our Commitment
Your Confidence, Our Priority
At The Handle Factory, we believe that every customer deserves a straightforward, transparent, and dependable shopping experience.
Operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD, our UK-based online store focuses on providing home heating solutions, fireplaces, generators, water heaters, saunas, boilers, and related accessories.

We understand that purchasing heating equipment and home improvement products is an important investment. That's why we're committed to helping our customers make informed decisions through clear product information, transparent policies, and accessible customer support.
Our commitment extends beyond the checkout process. We aim to provide helpful assistance before, during, and after your purchase.
1. Our Commitment to Product Quality
We understand the importance of choosing products that meet your requirements and expectations.
Our approach focuses on providing accurate information about the products available through our website.
We aim to:
* Offer products described accurately and clearly.
* Provide relevant specifications and product details.
* Identify product brands, models, and features correctly.
* Communicate important compatibility and installation requirements.
* Address product-related enquiries before and after purchase.
We recognise that products such as generators, fireplaces, boilers, and water heaters may require specialist knowledge or professional installation.
Customers should always follow manufacturer instructions and applicable safety regulations.
Where professional installation is required, we recommend using appropriately qualified installers.
2. Our Commitment to Transparent Pricing
We believe customers should understand the cost of their purchases before completing an order.
At The Handle Factory:
* All product prices are displayed in British Pounds Sterling (GBP, £).
* Applicable charges are disclosed during checkout.
* Standard shipping is free for eligible UK orders.
* There is no minimum order value for free standard shipping.
* We do not charge restocking fees for eligible returns.
Our aim is to provide clear pricing information without unexpected standard delivery charges.
3. Our Commitment to Free UK Shipping
We offer free standard shipping throughout the United Kingdom for eligible orders.
Our standard delivery arrangements are:

4. Our Commitment to Straightforward Returns
We understand that customers may occasionally need to return or exchange a product.
That's why we offer a 30-day return window for eligible purchases.
Our standard returns arrangements include:
* Returns accepted for defective products.
* Returns accepted for non-defective products.
* Exchanges accepted for eligible products.
* New-condition requirement for standard non-defective returns.
* Free prepaid return labels included in packages.
* Returns by post or an appropriate arranged carrier.
* No restocking fees.
* A standard refund processing target of 10 days.
For large or heavy equipment, our team can provide instructions for an appropriate return method.
Your statutory rights under applicable UK consumer protection legislation remain unaffected by our voluntary return arrangements.
For complete information, please review our Returns & Refunds Policy.
5. Our Commitment to Customer Support
We believe clear communication is an important part of good customer service.
Our support team can assist with:
* Product information and specifications
* Questions before purchasing
* Order confirmation and payment enquiries
* Delivery and tracking information
* Order changes and cancellations
* Returns, refunds, and exchanges
* Damaged or incorrect products
* Warranty and after-sales enquiries
Customers can contact us directly using the following details:
Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
We aim to review enquiries promptly and provide clear, relevant information.
6. Our Commitment to Responsible Product Information
Some products require careful consideration before purchase, particularly those involving heating systems, combustion appliances, electrical installations, or fuel-powered equipment.
We encourage customers to review product specifications, compatibility requirements, and safety guidance before ordering.
For example:
Fireplaces and Wood Stoves: Installation and use must comply with applicable building, ventilation, and fire safety requirements.
Generators: Fuel-burning generators must never be operated indoors or in enclosed spaces due to the risk of carbon monoxide poisoning.

Water Heaters and Boilers: Gas appliances must be installed or serviced by appropriately Gas Safe registered engineers where required. Electrical installations must comply with applicable safety requirements.
Saunas: Electrical connections, ventilation, and installation must follow manufacturer instructions and relevant safety standards.
Our customer support team can assist with general product information, but it does not replace the advice of a qualified installer or technical professional.
7. Our Commitment to Honest Communication
We aim to communicate clearly about our products, services, and policies.
This includes providing information about:
* Product features and specifications
* Pricing and payment options
* Estimated delivery times
* Return eligibility and procedures
* Refund processing
* Warranty information
* Customer support channels
If a customer encounters a problem, we encourage them to contact us so we can investigate and provide an appropriate resolution.
We believe transparent communication helps build long-term customer confidence.
8. Our Commitment to Privacy & Data Protection
We recognise the importance of protecting personal information.
We aim to handle customer data responsibly and in accordance with applicable UK data protection requirements.
Personal information may be used for purposes such as:
* Processing and fulfilling orders
* Arranging delivery
* Providing customer support
* Handling returns and refunds
* Communicating important order updates
* Meeting applicable legal obligations
For more information about how we collect, use, and protect personal information, please review our Privacy Policy.
Customers may contact info@thehandlefactory.uk with privacy-related enquiries.
9. Our Commitment to Fair Customer Treatment
We respect the rights of customers under applicable UK consumer protection laws.
Our store policies are intended to provide clear information about purchasing, delivery, returns, and after-sales support.
We recognise that customers may have statutory rights relating to:
* Goods that are faulty or not as described
* Goods that do not meet applicable quality standards
* Late or failed deliveries
* Cancellation of eligible distance purchases
* Refunds and other legally available remedies
Nothing in our store policies is intended to exclude or restrict consumer rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.
We aim to address customer concerns fairly and in accordance with applicable legal requirements.
10. Our Commitment to Continuous Improvement
We believe that improving the customer experience is an ongoing responsibility.
We aim to review and improve our website information, shopping processes, customer support procedures, and product presentation as our business develops.
Customer enquiries and feedback can help us identify areas where clearer information or improved service may be needed.
We welcome constructive feedback and encourage customers to share their experiences with our support team.
11. Our Promise to You
At The Handle Factory, our priorities are simple:
Clarity: Providing useful product information and understandable policies.
Transparency: Communicating pricing, delivery estimates, and return conditions clearly.
Convenience: Making it straightforward to browse products, place orders, and access support.
Fairness: Respecting applicable consumer rights and addressing concerns appropriately.
Support: Helping customers with enquiries throughout their purchasing experience.
We aim to make every interaction with The Handle Factory professional, helpful, and straightforward.
12. Contact The Handle Factory
If you have questions, feedback, or need assistance with an order, please contact us.
